about.html:
About the calculations

Kairos is a tool from the secret astrology of Kalachakra: act in accord with the active channel to transform karma on the path to enlightenment for the benefit of all beings. The concept of time follows the author's notes.

Time in Kalachakra

In the absolute all three times are present. Sacred time is always within us; the time of the material world begins when the mind separates itself from the one. Everything begins with thought, and breath is tied to thought, so time is measured in breaths: 21,600 a day for a healthy middle-aged person.

UnitMade ofLength
breathinhale, pause, exhale; 5 heartbeats4 s
astrological minute6 breaths24 s
astrological hour60 minutes24 min
day60 hours, 21,600 breaths24 h

The astrological hour on the Now tab is counted from sunrise: number = floor(minutes since sunrise / 24) + 1, from 1 to 60.

Three channels

ChannelWomenMenMeaningActivity
Solar (Pingala)leftrightpast, samsaradestroying, subjugating
Lunar (Ida)rightleftfuture, nirvanapacifying, increasing
Central (Rahu)moment of changepresent, the absolutemeditation

Channels after Shiva Swarodaya

The channel at sunrise is set by the lunar day (tithi) in force at sunrise: tithi = floor((Moon longitude − Sun longitude) / 12°) + 1. Days 1–3, 7–9, 13–15 of the waxing Moon start with the lunar channel, 4–6 and 10–12 with the solar; the waning Moon is the reverse. The channel then changes every 60 minutes until the next sunrise, where it is taken anew. The last stretch before sunrise is usually short and is shown as is.

Chinese hours

Twelve double hours on true solar time (the Sun's hour angle), starting with 子 at 23:00. Day pillar: (Julian day + 49) mod 60. The hour spirit (yellow and black path) follows the day branch; an hour clashing with the day is unfavourable.

Caveats

Hourly alternation is a textual norm; the real nasal cycle is usually 1.5–3 hours and irregular. Tibetan lunar day numbers may differ by one.
